frozen_before.coverage_of_the_predicate_against_known_: NOT measured at freeze time — see c_fork.coverage_measurement

the_problem_this_protocol_solves.finding: The qualified commitment fork is not identifiable from a natural trajectory. Two of the three R-conditions are counterfactual: 'not effectively_doomed' and 'persistent_divergence' both require branch utilities. Only 'enough_legal_responses' (>=2) is natural.
the_problem_this_protocol_solves.consequence: Under the response-supervision prohibition, O3 can never be handed control 'at the qualified fork'. That is a structural fact, not an oversight.
the_problem_this_protocol_solves.second_finding: Forks sit upstream of the carrier-pressure onset: median 25 decisions, mean 24.1, and 0 of 157 coincide with it. Handing off at the pressure onset would place O3 a median of 25 decisions AFTER the commitment it is supposed to make differently.
the_problem_this_protocol_solves.resolution: C_fork is a label-free precursor predicate over natural features, frozen below before its coverage was measured.

c_fork.name: carrier commitment precursor
c_fork.type: window-level, natural-trajectory-only, causally available at decision time
predicate_all_must_hold: blue is carrying (a blue carrier exists at this decision)
carrier_pressure > 0.18 — the carrier is NOT yet inside the pressure radius
carrier_pressure is decreasing over the previous 5 decisions — a ready threat is closing
c_fork.onset_rule: the FIRST decision in each carry phase satisfying all four conditions; one-way, at most one onset per carry phase

constants.pressure_radius_source: INHERITED from the frozen C3 contract runtime_cells.pressure_predicate.pressure_radius_frac
constants.closing_trend_window_status: the only new constant in this predicate; chosen as a short window that distinguishes a closing threat from noise, frozen before any coverage measurement

c_fork.why_this_shape: It fires while the carrier still has options and before pressure has arrived, which is where the counterfactual screen located the forks. It uses only the one R-condition that is natural (>=2 legal responses) plus geometry already frozen in the C3 contract.

coverage_measurement.what: the fraction of the 157 known qualified forks whose fork_step falls at or after a C_fork onset in the same episode
coverage_measurement.classification: EVALUATION-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC. It reads counterfactual labels and therefore may not influence the predicate, the thresholds, or any training decision.
coverage_measurement.explicitly_may_not: be used to tune the predicate. The predicate is frozen by this document; a low coverage number is a reportable limitation, not a licence to adjust the constants.

c_anchor.name: opportunity-matched carry state without the precursor
c_anchor.definition: decisions at which blue is carrying and n_legal_team_responses >= 2, but the C_fork precursor is NOT active — i.e. the carrier is inside the pressure radius, or no ready threat is closing
c_anchor.matching: matched to C_fork onsets on score stratum (leading/trailing/tied) and on decision-time bucket, so the contrast is not a proxy for score state or clock
c_anchor.explicitly_forbidden: episode-level splits such as 'episodes containing a fork' vs 'other episodes'. That construction reintroduced the confound that invalidated O1 gates 1-3 and is prohibited here.
c_anchor.rationale: The anchor must be a nearby state where the specialised response should NOT be needed, not a different kind of episode.

training.architecture: natural G0 prefix -> one-way handoff to O3 at the C_fork onset -> O3 controls the remainder of the episode
training.reset_distribution: natural episodes only; no synthetic or injected start states

credit_mask.pre_onset: O3 policy-loss weight 0; pre-onset rewards may not influence the O3 policy gradient
credit_mask.post_onset: O3 policy-loss weight 1; task reward only

training.initialization: fresh; warm start from G0, O1 or any prior specialist is FORBIDDEN

seeds.n_seeds_rationale: single-seed development mode, per the standing decision for C2/O2 and forward. A single-seed result may not be described as a reproducible strategy family.

primary_metric.name: post_onset_task_utility
primary_metric.definition: final score differential of the episode, blue_score - red_score, measured on episodes containing the relevant context
primary_metric.why: carrier_survival is the C3 SCREEN proxy, chosen to make controllability detectable in a bounded window. A crossover on it would establish that O3 keeps carriers alive for 30 decisions, not that it is a better team strategy. The primary claim must rest on a genuine task scalar.

evaluation.disjointness: the O3 training onset block (9820000+) and the demand-evaluation block (9830000+) are disjoint from each other and from every prior block: 9100000+, 9200000+, 9300000-2, 9400000+, 9500000+, 9600000+, 9700000/9710000/9720000 (reserved for latent birth), 9800001 (spent by C2), 9810000+ (Stage 4), 9900000+ (O1 panels)
evaluation.rule: no Stage-4 confirmation data may serve as the O3-vs-G0 test set
evaluation.fail_closed: the evaluation harness must abort on any seed collision

delta_fork.definition: E[U_task | C_fork, O3] - E[U_task | C_fork, G0]
delta_fork.construction: paired-prefix: identical seed, arm A is G0 throughout, arm B is G0 until the C_fork onset then O3

delta_anchor.definition: E[U_task | C_anchor, G0] - E[U_task | C_anchor, O3]
delta_anchor.requirement: delta_anchor > 0 with LCB95 > 0 — a genuine preference REVERSAL, not mere non-inferiority
delta_anchor.note: This is stricter than O1 gate 2, which only required O1 not to exceed G0 by more than a tolerance. A reversal is what distinguishes a specialist from a better generalist.

g_available.selector: within-episode, one-way, switches to O3 at the first C_fork onset

behavioral_nonredundancy.criterion_a: matched-observation action divergence at C_fork onsets (JSD, argmax disagreement) reported in full
behavioral_nonredundancy.single_seed_caveat: With one O3 seed the family-level B_distinct statistic is unavailable. This is a PAIRWISE distinction claim only and may not be described as a distinct strategy FAMILY.

disposition.O3 wins C_fork and dominates C_anchor to: BETTER_GENERALIST — consider replacing G0; K remains 1; no latent birth
disposition.O3 wins C_fork but G_available LCB95 <=: no repertoire value; no latent birth

prohibited: any use of counterfactual response labels in training, per 46c9e17
tuning the C_fork predicate using its measured coverage against known forks
using carrier_survival as the primary crossover metric
evaluating on Stage-4 or any prior block
adjusting any threshold after seeing an O3 result
describing a single-seed result as a reproducible strategy family
immutability: After any O3 training or evaluation outcome is observed, none of the above may change: the C_fork predicate or its constants, the C_anchor definition or matching variables, the credit mask, the primary metric, the seed blocks, the crossover requirements, the bootstrap procedure, the nonredundancy thresholds, or the disposition table.
